Hypothesis: _query in orders/repository.py (called (depth 3) from an anomalous route handler)

import statistics
import time
import tracemalloc

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from orders.app import app

client = TestClient(app)


def _call(method, url, body):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    response = client.request(method, url, content=body or None, headers={"content-type": "application/json"})
    return response, (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000


REQUEST = ('GET', '/orders', '')
BUDGET_P50_MS = 18.0  # pre-incident p50 6.01 ms, with margin
BUDGET_P95_MS = 29.2  # pre-incident p95 9.21 ms, with margin


def test_incident_request_stays_within_latency_budget():
    _call(*REQUEST)  # warm-up
    timings = sorted(_call(*REQUEST)[1] for _ in range(20))
    assert statistics.median(timings) <= BUDGET_P50_MS, timings
    assert timings[18] <= BUDGET_P95_MS, timings

import statistics
import time

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from orders.app import app


def test_get_orders_is_within_latency_budget():
    baseline_p50_ms = 6.01
    baseline_p95_ms = 9.21
    median_budget_ms = max(3 * baseline_p50_ms, baseline_p50_ms + 10)
    p95_budget_ms = max(2 * baseline_p95_ms, baseline_p95_ms + 20)

    with TestClient(app) as client:
        warmup_response = client.get("/orders")
        assert (
            warmup_response.status_code == 200
        ), f"Warmup GET /orders returned {warmup_response.status_code}, expected 200"

        latencies_ms = []
        for _ in range(20):
            start = time.perf_counter()
            response = client.get("/orders")
            elapsed_ms = (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000
            assert response.status_code == 200, (
                f"GET /orders returned {response.status_code}, expected 200"
            )
            latencies_ms.append(elapsed_ms)

    median_ms = statistics.median(latencies_ms)
    sorted_latencies_ms = sorted(latencies_ms)
    p95_index = (95 * len(sorted_latencies_ms) - 1) // 100
    p95_ms = sorted_latencies_ms[p95_index]

    assert median_ms <= median_budget_ms, (
        f"GET /orders median latency {median_ms:.2f} ms exceeded the healthy budget "
        f"of {median_budget_ms:.2f} ms derived from baseline p50 {baseline_p50_ms:.2f} ms"
    )
    assert p95_ms <= p95_budget_ms, (
        f"GET /orders p95 latency {p95_ms:.2f} ms exceeded the healthy budget "
        f"of {p95_budget_ms:.2f} ms derived from baseline p95 {baseline_p95_ms:.2f} ms"
    )
